### Changed
- **The kagent line at `1.2.0`, and `kagent.otel` in the chart's SDK-spec shape** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37742). `components.kagent.versionRange` and `components.kagent-crds.versionRange` are `>=1.2.0 <1.3.0` (upstream kagent `main@dd3b2405`, Substrate `1.1.0` unchanged). `kagent.otel` is `exporter.otlp.{endpoint,protocol,timeout}` (`auto`, `auto`, `"500"`: endpoint and protocol follow `global.observability.traces.otlp`), `traces.enabled` and `logs.enabled` (`auto`, off while the signal has no endpoint); `kagent.otel.tracing` and `kagent.otel.logging` are gone, and so is their `insecure` (the endpoint's scheme decides), and so are `OTEL_LOGGING_ENABLED` and `KAGENT_TRACE_FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS` in `kagent.harness.env`. The connectivity chart reads the same shape for the OTLP egress rules of the kagent controller and the Substrate egress gateway: a signal's own `endpoint` and `protocol`, else `exporter.otlp`'s. UPGRADE.md. The kagent log exporter honors the protocol on this line, so `global.observability.traces.otlp.protocol: http/protobuf` no longer fails the render over it.
